description.narrative: Contribution to URCS One Plan for addressing humanitarian needs across Ukraine through support to the following outcomes: Outcome 1: People directly impacted by the conflict can recover through effective, direct and inclusive local assistance (Home Based Care, MHPSS, Cash and Voucher Assistance, Winterisation, Emergency Response Outcome 2: Survivors of the conflict have access to physical and psychosocial rehabilitation (Mobile Rehabilitation Units, Disability inclusion activities, Inclusive playgrounds, URCS veterans hotline, Specialised Burn Unit) Outcome 3: The URCS is sustainable, accountable, and transparent with safeguarding embedded through their organisation (Safeguarding, Risk Management, Communications) Outcome 4: The URCS is an effective humanitarian auxiliary to and trusted partner of the Ukrainian Government, with strengthened capacities in IHL (IHL, HD and auxiliary role, Ukrainian Alliance of Civil Society Organisations)
